tasks.title: Define tracking-document domain types
tasks.dod: src/types/tracking-document.ts compiles with zero any; TrackingDocumentFilter/GetStatusDocumentsPayload match contracts/public-api.md §2 field-for-field; TrackingStatus types the full 118-field union (not the 103-field intersection) with StatusCode as a plain number and the 5 disputed fields as boolean | string per public-api.md §2; TRACKING_STATUS_CODES is exported as a documentation-only const, never used to narrow StatusCode; tsc --noEmit and lint pass

tasks.title: Implement getStatusDocuments (raw batch method)
tasks.dod: getStatusDocuments delegates to client.request("TrackingDocument", "getStatusDocuments", { Documents }) with the caller's Documents array passed through unmodified (no split/cap/reorder); a supplied Phone defaults to an empty string when omitted; a mocked-fetch unit test asserts a short/reordered/longer-than-requested response array is returned with every record's own Number field intact and unmodified; src/modules/tracking-document/index.ts imports nothing from src/modules/internet-document

tasks.title: Implement getDocumentStatus (single-waybill convenience, match-by-identity)
tasks.dod: getDocumentStatus makes exactly one call carrying a single-item Documents array, then resolves the result by exact string comparison of the returned record's Number field against the requested documentNumber (no trimming/case-folding); zero matches resolves undefined; more than one match throws NovaPoshtaApiError; each of the three outcomes has a mocked-fetch unit test
